title: Human-Governed AI Delivery Method
summary: A reusable delivery methodology combining human-owned product direction with AI-assisted implementation, independent verification, durable handoffs and automated quality gates.
ownership: Method owner, product director and release authority
constraints: Product direction, content decisions and release approval had to remain human-owned throughout AI-assisted implementation.
Implementation and verification needed distinct roles, durable context and explicit acceptance gates.
practices: Define separate implementation and verification roles with explicit ownership, handoffs and review gates.
Apply the method across Astro delivery, interactive 2.5D storytelling, accessibility, content and document production.
Set repeatable acceptance criteria for content quality, responsive behaviour, accessibility and browser reliability.
validation: The public repository contains durable delivery records, decisions, handoffs, risks and automated quality checks.
Unit, browser, accessibility, content and build tests cover the resulting portfolio release.
outcome: Used to deliver and verify the professional Static View and Explore Anzania as one release with a public audit trail and repeatable quality checks.
limitations: This methodology is demonstrated through the portfolio release; it is not a standalone software product or client engagement.
